title: Let valid previews finish loading without startup deadlines
body:
The installed failure was localized to trusted asset admission. The actual 637494-byte JPEG takes 1284 ms in CPU admission before the first heartbeat. The user explicitly removed both startup deadlines and requested that initialization take as long as necessary.

Acceptance:
- Preview initialization has no fixed five-second cap or missing-heartbeat termination before promotion.
- Loading stages appear in the active build job.
- Explicit worker failures retain the accepted preview and user files.
- The accepted runtime retains its existing watchdog.
- Independent review, installed full-texture MCP demonstration, and handoff remain checklist items.

Source compiler/linker deadlines are separate and unchanged. Closing the app stops a stuck load; there is no new Cancel Build action.
reason: Apply the user's latest explicit startup policy; it supersedes the initial five-second-cap acceptance.
